title: Uniform effective log-Iitaka systems for fourfolds
exact_target: Given finite $\Phi \subset [0,1]\cap Q$, does some positive $m(\Phi )$ make $|\lfloor m(K_X+\Delta )\rfloor |$ nonempty and make its ratios generate the full Iitaka field for every normal integral projective complex lc fourfold $(X,\Delta )$ with effective rational boundary coefficients in $\Phi $ and rational Cartier pseudo-effective $K_X+\Delta $? The same m must work for every chosen canonical divisor.
